steps.name: apply-vpd-coverage-and-update-benchmark-expectations
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f0bcc1ed7d201a712784563d1d5acacebad55313; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9a/apply_stage9a.py > /tmp/growbox-stage9a.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/growbox-stage9a.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/test_climate_benchmark.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from tools.ml.climate_scenarios import ClimateProfile, build_training_episode', 'from tools.ml.climate_scenarios import (
    REQUIRED_SCENARIO_FAMILIES,
    ClimateProfile,
    build_training_episode,
)')
s=s.replace('    assert len(report.families) == 13
    assert len(report.episodes) == 39
    for metrics in report.aggregate.values():
        assert metrics.steps == 13 * 6
', '    family_count = len(REQUIRED_SCENARIO_FAMILIES)
    assert len(report.families) == family_count
    assert len(report.episodes) == family_count * 3
    for metrics in report.aggregate.values():
        assert metrics.steps == family_count * 6
')
p.write_text(s)
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-vpd-and-benchmark-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_input.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py -q; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9a/focused_vpd_gate.py > /tmp/growbox-stage9a-focused.py; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python /tmp/growbox-stage9a-focused.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add RH and VPD dataset coverage'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
